nodes.name: sensory neuron of campaniform sensillum
nodes.note: General campaniform class; upstream of b1 resolves it at tw=3572.

nodes.name: sensory neuron of wing campaniform sensillum
nodes.note: Wing campaniform; upstream of b1 at tw=1818.

nodes.name: sensory neuron of haltere campaniform sensillum
nodes.note: Haltere campaniform; upstream of b1 at tw=1754.

nodes.name: b1 motor neuron (wing basalar muscle b1)
nodes.note: Tonic wing steering motor neuron; monosynaptic target of tegula campaniform sensilla (Lesser et al. 2026).

nodes.name: bristle mechanosensory neuron
nodes.note: General bristle class; 0 API rows downstream in every form (GAPS.md §6).

nodes.name: sensory neuron of wing bristle
nodes.note: Wing bristle BMN; the CTN paper stimulated wing-margin bristles.

nodes.name: Mago-no-Te (MGT) command neuron
nodes.note: NO FBbt class (too new for the ontology). Pair of cholinergic command-like neurons for thoracic grooming; posterior macrochaete bristle BMNs synapse onto MGT (t-GRASP + FANC EM).

nodes.name: central Tmc-L neuron (CTN)
nodes.note: NO FBbt class. Central neurons expressing Tmc-L; wing-margin bristle mechanoreceptors drive CTNs (ATP/P2X2 + GCaMP) to mediate defensive behavior.

edges.citation: VFBquery /run_query UpstreamClassConnectivity of FBbt_00004066 (b1), FlyWire FAFB v783
edges.note: Class-level downstream of campaniform is broken (0 rows); the upstream query of b1 resolves the same synapse set. Ontology-duplicate labels (mechanosensory neuron tw=3572 etc.) are the same underlying rows, not independent.

edges.citation: VFBquery /run_query UpstreamClassConnectivity of FBbt_00004066, FlyWire FAFB v783
VFBquery /run_query UpstreamClassConnectivity of FBbt_00004066, FlyWire FAFB v783
Lesser, Moussa & Tuthill, eLife 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.05.29.656810): 'campaniform sensilla on the tegula synapse directly onto the tonic wing b1 motor neuron' (FANC EM reconstructions)
edges.note: Independent EM confirmation of the API-resolved wing campaniform -> b1 edge. Kept as a separate provenance-labeled edge; same synapse set, not double-counted.

edges.citation: Yoshikawa, Tang & Simpson, Curr Biol (bioRxiv 2023.11.19.567707; PMC10690200): 'Posterior macrochaete mechanosensory bristle neurons synapse onto MGT' (t-GRASP + FANC/MANC EM); synapse counts in paper Fig 4C (posterior > anterior), not extracted here
edges.note: Placeholder weight: no synapse counts extracted. MGT has no FBbt class. The API holds zero rows for this edge in any reachable form.

edges.citation: Nat Commun 2020 s41467-020-17771-8 ('A neural circuit encoding mating states tunes defensive behavior in Drosophila'): wing-margin bristle mechanoreceptors (GMR45E03-Gal4) drive CTNs (ATP/P2X2 stimulation + GCaMP); CTN activation/silencing bidirectionally controls defensive response
edges.note: Placeholder weight. CTN has no FBbt class. Functional connectivity shown; monosynapticity not proven (same caveat class as vPN1->pC1).

honest_note: PROVENANCE SPLIT — read before using. CAMPANIFORM: 3 REAL edges (campaniform classes -> b1 motor neuron, measured VFBquery upstream rows, tw=3572/1818/1754) + 1 LITERATURE-CONFIRMED edge (independent FANC EM confirmation of wing campaniform -> b1; same synapse set, not double-counted). BRISTLE: 2 LITERATURE-HYPOTHESIS edges (bristle BMN -> MGT; wing bristle -> CTN), each with its citation; placeholder weight 1; MGT and CTN have NO FBbt classes (too new for the ontology) and the API holds zero rows for bristle downstream in any reachable form (GAPS.md §6/§6b: class-level 0 rows, per-pair server death, Neuprint-only instances). Never present hypothesis edges as measured wiring.
